    3

    FIRE Number

    FIRE = Financial Independence, Retire Early. The idea: build a pot big enough that its returns cover your lifestyle for good. Set your numbers below and we'll show your target — and the monthly savings to hit it.

    Set your FIRE plan

    your numbers drive everything below →
    PAY CHEQUE
    Essentials, per month
    Food · Bills & living expenses · Groceries / toiletries · Phone bill · Insurance
    PLAY CHEQUE
    Lifestyle, per month
    Hobbies · Travel · Miscellaneous
    Your Play Cheque is the fun money — the lifestyle you want to keep funding even after you stop working. Splitting "needs" (Pay Cheque) from "wants" (Play Cheque) keeps the plan honest: you can dial the Play Cheque up or down and instantly see how your FIRE number moves.
    TOTAL (NOW):
    Pay Cheque + Play Cheque — your lifestyle today
